note: Scene tags read by the app's CLIP ViT-B/32 from the whole picture (centre square). Each tag compares its own prompts with its 'against' prompts; the tag is given only when the measured threshold in thresholds.json is passed. Prompts are English model input only; the words people see live in src/i18n/areas/photoTags. Regenerate vectors.json with tools/scene-tags/make_scene_vectors.py and thresholds.json with tools/scene-tags/measure_thresholds.py after any change.
